name: Icon button
purpose: Trigger a compact action with an accessible name

name: Split button
purpose: Offer a primary action and related menu

name: Top application bar
purpose: Show project identity and global actions

name: Tool rail
purpose: Expose stable tool categories and active tool

name: Context bar
purpose: Expose immediate controls for the active tool or selection

name: Status bar
purpose: Show units, snap, selection, save, sync and model health

name: Model tree
purpose: Navigate levels, views, sheets, imports and elements

name: Inspector
purpose: Edit and inspect selected object properties

name: Property row
purpose: Show label, value, inheritance and validation

name: Inline validation
purpose: Explain a field or object problem

name: Canvas
purpose: Render and interact with plan, model or sheet

name: Snap glyph
purpose: Show active snap type and source

name: Numeric overlay
purpose: Enter distance and angle during a command

name: Comment pin
purpose: Anchor a comment to model or sheet

name: Revision badge
purpose: Show draft, review or issued state

name: Compare legend
purpose: Explain added, modified and deleted objects

name: Sync state
purpose: Distinguish local save from cloud sync

name: File row
purpose: Show file name, status, size and actions

name: Job progress
purpose: Show import or export stage and cancellation
